title: unlimited combinations, create a constant
style: Show tune with big band and swing influences. Baritone male vocals lead with a theatrical delivery. The arrangement features a brass section with trumpets, trombones, and saxophones performing staccato stabs and melodic counterpoints. A walking bassline on an upright bass locks with a swing-patterned drum kit featuring prominent ride cymbal and snare brushes. A grand piano provides rhythmic comping and melodic fills. The track is in C major at 135 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance includes harmonized backing vocals during the chorus. The arrangement builds with brass swells and ends with a sudden stop followed by a brief, playful piano and bass outro.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[upright bass walking line, swing drums, piano comping]
[brass section stabs]

[Verse 1]
[baritone male vocals]
Every ball you hit will never be the same
The way it's received
The way it's delivered
And everything in between
Have you thought about how many possible ball combinations you will ever play?
It's endless

[Chorus]
[brass section enters with melodic lines]
If each ball is different, how can I?
If each ball is different, how can we?
Flow like water
Create a constant [backing vocals join]
Take advantage
Position yourself
Create a constant
Create stability
Position yourself
Create a constant
Minimize probability
Position yourself
Create a constant
Set your optimal ball height [vocal ascends]
Position yourself
Create a constant [sustained brass chord]

[Outro]
Minimize factors
[drums and brass stop]
[piano and bass playful staccato riff]
